estimate.unit: active engineer hours with AI assistance
estimate.meaning: Planning arithmetic, not a calibrated probability interval or autonomous-agent completion promise.
estimate.externalHumanEffort: Independent BA/domain review and participant time are additional; quantify at MR-01/MR-02.

sprints.title: Product contract, proposal revision and implementation baseline
sprints.goal: Freeze the document-to-visual-review product contract before implementation.
work: Record BA, stakeholder and developer responsibilities and the complete first-use journey.
Write the English proposal revision draft and a delta against the existing English proposal; distinguish the unavailable university-approved original.
Inventory reusable code from main and PRs #8/#9 by path, licensing and test coverage; select explicit ports rather than merging pending PRs implicitly.
Define CI triggers for feature PRs targeting major-revision-1, supported input limits, language, browser matrix and risk gates.

Build a focused related-work matrix covering requirements-to-diagram generation, BA/human review, source traceability and stakeholder evaluation; narrow the research gap without claiming first-ever novelty.
done: The contract maps every current owner requirement to a sprint and observable acceptance evidence.
The revised research question, contribution boundaries and study assumptions are written; academic approval is recorded separately.
The reuse decision names paths/commits and the migration strategy preserves v1 saved specifications.
Quality thresholds and corpus split are frozen before model tuning; implementation can proceed without another scope question.
The proposal's research gap is supported by primary literature and distinguishes existing techniques from the contribution being evaluated.
tests: Trace a new specification through BA correction, stakeholder question and proposed revision; every transition has an owner and persisted artifact.
List v1 readers, source/review sidecars, Auth/API paths and regression coverage; document every proposed change.
A feature PR against major-revision-1 triggers the required checks without production secrets.

sprints.title: Reference documents, independent annotations and baseline
sprints.goal: Create a small, auditable cross-domain corpus and an independent semantic reference.
work: Prepare six English text/Markdown specifications from three domains, initially SetPilot access/reporting, commerce and booking; two documents per domain.
Use bounded documents of approximately 1,500–6,000 characters with explicit conditions, decisions and exceptions; record rights and document hashes.
Split three development and three held-out documents before tuning; include an ambiguous document and an incomplete document.
An independent BA/domain reviewer checks source spans and critical facts; disagreement is adjudicated and retained.
done: All six documents have versioned IDs, provenance/rights, split membership and critical-fact annotations.
Every reference fact/relationship has a source span or an explicit missing-information label.
The reference records draft annotations, independent review and adjudication separately; unreviewed data cannot be called an independent benchmark.
Current main/manual and heuristic-importer behavior is measured as a baseline with its supported input limits.
tests: Alter a source document; its old hash and dependent reference are rejected as current.
The split manifest prevents held-out documents from entering tuning prompts/examples.
A second human reviewer records agreement/disagreement and resolutions without copying the model answer.

sprints.title: Document intake and versioned semantic records
sprints.goal: Accept a real specification and preserve its text, identity and traceable semantic records.
work: Add bounded UTF-8 .txt/.md upload and paste; preserve original bytes/text, normalized text, digest and exact span mapping.
Define a versioned model for source documents, actors, rules, triggers, actions, conditions, decisions, relations and questions.
Keep origin classification (explicit, inferred, human-added) separate from review state (proposed, accepted, rejected, unresolved).
Add export/import and an explicit adapter boundary to legacy Specification v1; retain unsupported content as source rather than dropping it.
done: A supported uploaded document can be reopened and exported without source loss.
Invalid size/type/encoding, duplicate IDs, bad spans and dangling links fail with an actionable result.
Every semantic record retains document revision and evidence; partial extraction is visible.
No legacy saved record is silently migrated or overwritten.
tests: Accept valid text including Unicode; reject empty, oversized and unsupported files; source spans still select the exact original quotation.
Reject duplicate IDs and invalid relation endpoints; preserve unsupported paragraphs in the source view.
Export/import preserves source and records; existing v1 fixtures still load unchanged.

sprints.title: Real model extraction and grounding
sprints.goal: Prove a real model can propose grounded records from the uploaded document.
work: Select one provider/model after a documented capability, availability and cost check; implement a server-only adapter with schema validation.
Treat document text as untrusted data; provide no tool execution, browsing or repository authority to extracted instructions.
Validate evidence spans and relation endpoints; label inferences and omissions instead of manufacturing approvals.
Bound input/output, request timeout, retry count and spend; record model/version, prompt hash, usage and errors without exposing private text publicly.
done: At least one real credentialed provider request over development documents is evidenced; mocks alone do not satisfy the sprint.
The UI identifies the selected provider and outbound data action; no credential appears in the client, Git history or artifact.
Malformed/truncated responses and invalid evidence leave the previous document/model intact.
Development-set raw precision, recall, critical omissions, latency and usage are reported; gate G1 is explicitly passed or stopped.
tests: Missing configuration, timeout, rate limit, malformed JSON and truncated output preserve prior work and allow bounded retry.
Unsupported evidence and dangling links are rejected; malicious instructions inside the source never become tools, approvals or code execution.
Record actual request metadata, source/prompt/model hashes and resulting validated records for the development corpus.

sprints.title: Business analyst review workbench
sprints.goal: Let the BA control and correct the interpretation without losing its origin.
work: Show source and proposed records together with accept, edit, reject and unresolved actions.
Support a human-added fact/question with rationale and explicit origin; approval never rewrites source history.
Persist revision-bound actions locally for the first slice; export all review decisions.
Mark previous decisions stale when dependent source/record content changes.
done: The BA can correct an extraction and inspect its original evidence and model proposal.
Proposals, accepted interpretations and unresolved questions remain visibly distinct.
Reload preserves decisions; failed storage writes and another-tab conflicts cannot silently replace work.
Changed source/records invalidate only the documented dependent decisions and retain prior history.
tests: Edit a proposed relation, reject an invented action and add a human question; each action retains author role, reason and source revision.
Change a source span or relation; its prior review becomes stale and cannot be exported as current acceptance.
Exercise save failure, corrupt storage and concurrent-tab edit without silent data loss.

sprints.title: Source-linked visual and text projections
sprints.goal: Complete the first real document-to-visual-review journey.
work: Render a deterministic actor-lane behavior graph with triggers, decisions, conditions, actions and exceptions from the reviewed model.
Selecting a node or relation reveals its exact source span and review/origin state.
Provide an equivalent structured-text projection from the same canonical records, including unknowns.
Use the same pipeline for a fresh document with no document-specific code path or pre-authored graph.
done: A fresh supported document passes upload, real extraction, BA correction, graph inspection and export end to end.
Graph topology changes when the underlying relations change; the view is a model projection rather than fixed sample artwork.
Every displayed factual node/relation has valid evidence or an explicit human/inferred/unknown label.
Visual/text material facts and states match; keyboard operation, narrow layout and a readable text alternative work.
tests: Import a previously unused supported document through the normal UI and trace selected visual elements back to exact source passages.
Change an actor, condition and branch; both visual and text projections update from the same records without lost questions.
Navigate node details and source links at 390px and desktop widths without pointer-only actions or clipped essential content.

sprints.title: Cross-domain fidelity and uncertainty quality gate
sprints.goal: Measure the pipeline against independent references, including incomplete specifications.
work: Freeze extraction settings, run the held-out corpus and compare facts/relationships with adjudicated references.
Report raw extraction and BA-corrected quality separately; track BA correction count/effort and model usage.
Handle queued/scheduled/background paths as source-supported behavior or open questions according to evidence.
Implement missing-information and unsupported-relationship reports with source links; preserve coverage denominators.
done: All three held-out documents use the generic path and have item-level errors and correction records.
Gate G3 thresholds are evaluated against a frozen reference; failed thresholds cause a recorded correction/retest cycle, not an unannounced threshold change.
A source-supported path, a speculative path and a genuinely unspecified condition are distinguishable in UI and exports.
No benchmark result is described as universal semantic correctness.
tests: An explicitly stated queued delivery path is extracted with its source condition and remains unapproved until human review.
An unstated post-revocation rule stays an open question; selecting a speculative path does not create an approved workflow.
Publish per-document denominators, raw/corrected precision and recall, critical omissions, invalid links and human adjudications.

sprints.title: Durable shared projects and role authorization
sprints.goal: Allow a BA and invited stakeholders to review the same durable project across devices.
work: Persist source revisions, semantic model, review decisions and questions in a versioned Neon project envelope through authenticated server routes.
Add project membership/invitation and BA/editor/reviewer permissions enforced by the server.
Support invitation expiry/revocation, optimistic revision checks and explicit local-draft reconciliation.
Use an isolated database branch for migrations and recovery tests; document backup/export and revocation limits.
done: Two independent authenticated users can open the same invited project on different browser contexts and read the same saved revision.
Reviewers cannot alter authoritative source/BA decisions; unrelated users cannot read, write or export the project.
Reload/new browser preserves the whole review envelope; stale concurrent updates are rejected without silent loss.
Migration/recovery has evidence on an isolated branch; existing v1 projects remain readable.
tests: BA saves, invited reviewer reloads in a fresh context and sees the exact same document/model/review revision.
Unauthenticated, unrelated and revoked users cannot read/write/export; reviewer source mutation and cross-project access are denied.
Two clients submit the same base revision; one stale write is rejected; legacy data and failed migrations remain recoverable.

sprints.title: Stakeholder feedback and requirement change loop
sprints.goal: Connect stakeholder understanding and disagreement to reviewable specification changes.
work: Provide a simplified stakeholder view with progressive disclosure, questions, disagreement and proposed-change actions.
Persist feedback against exact node/relation/source revision; track resolution, rationale and the responsible role.
Allow the BA to propose an explicit new source/model revision and show impact on earlier decisions.
Add bounded links to an external prototype and hypothesis/test/metric/threshold/evidence records; do not generate an application or claim market success.
done: A stakeholder question survives reload and is visible to the BA on the shared project.
Feedback can be resolved or converted to a proposed change without silently editing the original source.
Accepting a source revision exposes affected interpretations/decisions and retains the complete previous revision.
A hypothesis record distinguishes untested, evidence recorded and decision made; an external prototype link is clearly external.
tests: An invited reviewer attaches a question to a branch; the BA sees and resolves it with a source-linked rationale.
A changed condition stales the affected decisions while preserving unrelated feedback and historical exports.
Save prototype/hypothesis/test evidence; no entry grants behavior approval, proof of implementation or market validation.

sprints.title: Evaluation protocol and scoring for the revised question
sprints.goal: Prepare a fair study of BA-mediated visual review and a replayable evaluation tool.
work: Revise the English study protocol and preserve equivalent source/model facts in both conditions with comparable BA facilitation.
Define primary comprehension/gap-detection outcomes and separate extraction fidelity, BA effort and subjective usability.
Extend reference/scoring schemas if insufficient information is a correct answer; retain unsure as abstention where specified.
Define recruitment/unit of analysis/sample justification, coding procedure, ordering, answer-key access and data handling with supervisor input.
done: The protocol distinguishes visual presentation effects from model extraction quality and BA presence.
A paired session is the analysis unit when pairs are used; sample size is justified rather than inherited as 12 or 24.
Synthetic sessions replay exactly against a separately controlled reference, including a valid insufficient-information answer.
Research authorization/consent and supervisor decisions remain explicit prerequisites to human data collection.
tests: Both conditions preserve the same substantive records and use the same BA facilitation script and limits.
Correct mismatch, no mismatch and insufficient-information references score as designed; unsure/abstention and missing answers remain distinct.
Recompute synthetic session scores from a frozen reference; participant bundles/artifacts do not contain the actual answer key.

sprints.title: System verification, accessibility and failure recovery
sprints.goal: Verify the complete revised workflow with named positive and negative evidence.
work: Run the full regression suite and new source/provider/project/review browser flows in the agreed four browser projects.
Audit source-based graph correctness separately from graph rendering and inspect representative screenshots.
Test malicious document content, access isolation, failed saves, interrupted extraction, concurrent updates and recovery.
Measure response/interaction performance at the supported input limits and document remaining usability issues.
done: Every acceptance case has a result, exact commit, command/run, environment and evidence link; blocked/skipped cases stay visible.
Node/Python checks, type checking, build and all required browser suites pass on the exact candidate.
No unresolved blocker/high-severity defect remains in the core journey, access controls or data preservation.
Accessibility evidence covers automated checks plus a manual keyboard/readability walkthrough; no certification claim is made.
tests: Run upload, real extraction, BA correction, source navigation, invite, stakeholder feedback, revised source, reload and export.
Run prompt-injection, malformed output, provider interruption, denied access, save failure and concurrent update scenarios.
Record named cases in desktop/mobile Chromium, desktop Firefox and mobile WebKit; review keyboard and screenshots.

sprints.title: Independent demo and engineering release candidate
sprints.goal: Deliver an inspectable candidate with honest demo and live-model modes.
work: Deploy to an isolated preview/demo project with synthetic samples and a working Reset demo sample control.
Keep public sample exploration separate from credentialed live document extraction; identify cached samples and real calls clearly.
Write the revised English quickstart/user manual and setup/migration/known-limit documentation.
Bind deployment, CI and evidence manifests to the same candidate commit; prepare rollback and owner publication decision.
done: The public sample opens in a fresh unauthenticated browser without a hosting login and exposes no private project or model credential.
Reset restores the sample exactly and cannot erase unrelated user/project data.
A credentialed live-mode smoke proves the real pipeline; public cached-mode evidence is labeled separately.
Candidate URL, version, commit, CI, manual and unresolved research dependencies are documented; merge/production remain owner decisions.
tests: Edit a synthetic sample, cancel reset, confirm reset and reload; verify exact restoration in a fresh browser.
Public sample requests cannot reach private data or an unrestricted paid model endpoint; live mode requires its documented authorization/budget limits.
Match CI checkout/head, deployed source revision, artifact hashes and migration version; verify rollback procedure.

sprints.title: Human formative pilot and bounded corrections
sprints.goal: Check whether intended users can actually perform the workflow before an empirical study.
work: After the required research/consent approvals, run at least two formative review sessions involving a BA and nondeveloper stakeholders.
Use the revised artifact, source documents and facilitator script; observe comprehension, task completion, confusing language and BA interventions.
Separate observed user problems from researcher interpretations and implement one bounded correction cycle.
Re-run affected automated/live checks and record unresolved limitations; freeze material changes before a formal study.
done: Actual consented human sessions have dated evidence and a transparent participant/session description; bots or developer self-tests do not count.
Each observed blocker has a fix/retest or a documented deferral and its implication for study readiness.
The resulting readiness decision is reviewed by the researcher/supervisor as applicable.
No significance, market-fit or general effectiveness claim is drawn from the formative pilot.
tests: Observe users predicting a normal and an exceptional/background outcome and explaining the source evidence.
Observe a BA correcting a misunderstanding and a stakeholder submitting a traceable concern without developer coaching.
Re-test each implemented pilot correction with the affected browser/core scenarios and, when material, a human follow-up.

sprints.title: Open-source research artifact and final handoff
sprints.goal: Package an installable, inspectable research artifact and an explicit acceptance record.
work: Record the owner's license/rights decision, dependency notices and sample/data publication permissions before applying a license.
Package source, English setup/manual, architecture, synthetic corpus, prompt/model configuration, scenario catalog, scripts and permitted evaluation material.
Verify installation and synthetic evaluation replay from a clean checkout with no project-private files.
Prepare a versioned release candidate, contribution guidance and final product/research acceptance matrix; publish only within explicit owner authorization.
done: An appropriate software license and required notices are present after the rights decision; public-repository visibility alone is never called open source.
A clean environment can install, run the synthetic sample, execute tests and replay permitted evaluation records using documented steps.
Real participant data/keys/private documents are excluded unless publication is separately permitted; model nondeterminism is explained.
All requirements link to evidence or a named limitation; engineering, pilot, publication and formal study outcomes have separate statuses.
tests: Install and run sample/tests/replay without undocumented local files or private credentials; report where a live provider is needed.
Check license/notices, sample rights and accidental secrets/participant identifiers in the artifact.
Every requirement points to versioned evidence; no planned/blocked/human-pending item appears as completed.
